title: Started a new position: Course Facilitator for the Algorithms and Data Structures course at UH
content: I am very excited to start a new position as a Course Facilitator for the Algorithms and Data Structures course at UH. I am very excited to be able to help students learn and grow in their skills.

title: ICPC 2025 South Regionals Gold - 1st Place @ UH Site
content: Secured a gold medal at ICPC 2025 South Regionals by placing first at the UH site. Always proud to represent my university and deliver strong performances at ICPC. Check out the [ICPC 2025 South Regionals](https://icpc.global/regionals/finder/SCUSA-2026/standings) for more details. Our team name was **CoogLimitExceeded**.

title: Completed CodePath Technical Interview Prep & Cybersecurity Courses
content: Earned CodePath certificates in Intermediate Technical Interview Prep (TIP 102) and Intro to Cybersecurity (CYB 101), topped off with the Emerging Engineers Summit—great experience, highly recommended!
